checklist.notes: The timeline and repeated bus-number/time/gate key make meaning and success conditions explicit.
Each section reuses one station scenario and only three facts, keeping the multi-strand load bounded for A2.1.
The timetable, request, mediation, temporal frame, and word-stress work form one continuous station task.
Past-in-progress framing, transfer of timetable facts, a polite station request, and integrated retelling address narration, mediation, and socially suitable help.
The learner moves from temporal framing to written mediation, then interaction and integrated production; broader request comparison is reserved for consolidation.
A timeline, exact three-fact key, role model, word-stress cue, and final fact check provide concrete instruction and feedback.
Explicit stress placement and light unstressed syllables are useful, non-stereotyping supports.
